prompt: How many national flags of countries recognized as United Nations (UN) member or observer states have had their most recent official adoption date since 2010?
answer:
Using the **latest officially adopted, re-adopted, or legally revised version** of each national flag—and counting 2010 itself—the answer is **12**.

| State | Most recent official flag date |
|---|---:|
| Myanmar | 21 October 2010 |
| Serbia | 11 November 2010 |
| Libya | 3 August 2011 |
| Mongolia | 9 July 2011 |
| South Korea | 30 May 2011 |
| South Sudan | 9 July 2011 |
| Belarus | 2012 |
| Malawi | 28 May 2012 |
| Afghanistan | 19 August 2013 |
| Paraguay | 2013 |
| Mauritania | 5 August 2017 |
| Kyrgyzstan | December 2023 |

This covers the **193 UN member states plus the Holy See and State of Palestine**; neither observer state has a qualifying post-2010 flag date. Transitional or de facto flags—such as Syria’s post-2024 flag—are excluded because their international official status remains unsettled.
